summary: Plan complete: add a distinct checks_state 'unknown' (schema + plugin catch), fix the auto-merge decideReadiness fall-through (unknown -> retry_wait), audit all fall-through consumers, update docs + regenerate the bundle, and lock it with regression tests that drive the real error path. Resolved the delegated confirmation policy to P0 (no confirmation-before-rework) with recorded reasoning; kept Promise.all (any lookup error -> unknown, never salvage a partial 'passing').

details.chosen_approach: Additive 'unknown' enum member on checks_state, mirroring the existing merge_state.unknown precedent — simplest and idiomatic; boolean-flag and catch-further-out alternatives rejected.
details.delegated_decision_resolved: Confirmation-before-rework policy = P0 (none). A genuine failing value reworks immediately; the unknown fix resolves the reported lookup-error bug, P2 cross-poll confirmation would break the stateless-poller invariant (an architecture change), and existing max_blocker_reentries already bounds any flaky-value damage. Not surfaced for owner sign-off because the owner delegated the choice and P0 introduces no high-stakes change.
details.latent_bug_confirmed: auto-merge.ts decideReadiness falls through to disposition:'merge' on checks_state 'unknown' — must add an unknown -> retry_wait branch or the enum change silently enables merging on unverified CI.
details.consumer_audit: Re-grepped all checks_state consumers; inventory is exhaustive (6 branching sites + the fake-plugin test double + log-only sites). Only adapters.ts, github-hosting.ts, and auto-merge.ts need code; the rest fall through correctly and get regression tests.
details.gates: Plan verifies via pnpm run typecheck, pnpm run lint, pnpm test, pnpm run test:integration; the key AC-#10 regression drives a real Octokit rejection so it fails if the catch reverts to 'failing'.
